composites.DOMAIN_BALANCED: 三群等權；群內凍結方向因子等權；只有開發期 q<0.05 的因子納入
composites.OVERNIGHT_PAIR: F02 與 F04 兩個隔夜反轉因子等權，作為窄訊號對照

factor_direction_source: 2016-2021 only; HAC + BH q<0.05; same exact v1.0 baseline SHA

portfolio.exit: close on H-th market trading day
portfolio.benchmark: same-day eligible universe with composite factors and forward label available

holdout_caveat: 2024+ has appeared in prior SSO research; it is not a pristine unseen holdout.
limitations: Strict complete-case composite universe differs from standalone factor universes.
Factor composites are rank-based, fixed equal weights; no weight optimization or retuning is performed.
The 3 domains are research-defined categories, not empirically estimated latent factors.
Daily TopN cohorts are not a compounded account backtest; overlapping holdings and capital use are not netted.
Historical point-in-time universe / delisted securities survivorship audit is incomplete.
Minimum commission, bid-ask spread, price-limit queue, partial fills and order-book depth are not modelled.
Official turnover amount is unavailable; volume factor uses raw share-volume anomaly only.
